name: 7-Day Movement Kickstart
description: Move your body every day for 7 days — even 10 minutes counts. Build the habit first, the intensity follows.
daily_tasks: Day 7: Complete any workout from the library

name: 14-Day Strength Builder
description: Two weeks of progressive strength training to build a foundation. Three workouts per week with rest days.
daily_tasks: Day 2: Rest — take a gentle walk if you like
Day 6: Rest — try a 20-Min Mobility Flow
Day 14: Complete any workout — you pick!

name: 21-Day Bone Health Focus
description: Three weeks of workouts and habits specifically chosen to support your bone health through strength and balance training.
daily_tasks: Day 2: 10-Min Morning Stretch + balance practice (30 sec each leg)
Day 3: Rest day — read a Bone Health Hub article
Day 8: 10-Min Low-Impact Flow + calf raises (3 sets of 15)
Day 11: 10-Min Morning Stretch + single-leg stands (30 sec each)
Day 12: Rest day — read a Bone Health Hub article
Day 16: 20-Min Full Body with Dumbbells (or bodyweight version)
Day 21: Complete your favorite workout — celebrate your progress!

name: 7-Day Core Challenge
description: Strengthen your deep core muscles in just one week with daily 10-minute core sessions.
daily_tasks: Day 1: Dead bugs (3 x 8 each side) + Bird dogs (3 x 8 each side)
Day 2: Forearm plank (3 x 20 sec) + Glute bridges (3 x 12)
Day 4: Dead bugs (3 x 10 each side) + Side plank (3 x 15 sec each side)
Day 5: Bird dogs (3 x 10 each side) + Glute kickbacks (3 x 10 each side)
Day 6: Forearm plank (3 x 25 sec) + Pallof press if you have a band (3 x 10 each side)
Day 7: 10-Min Core Blast workout — you've built up to it!

name: 30-Day Healthy Habits
description: Build lasting fitness, nutrition, and wellness habits over 30 days. Combines workouts, stretching, walks, and self-care.
daily_tasks: Day 1: 10-Min Morning Stretch + set your goals for the month
Day 3: 15-minute walk + drink 8 glasses of water
Day 4: Rest day — prep a healthy meal from your plan
Day 7: Rest — read a Bone Health Hub article
Day 14: Rest — reflect on your first 2 weeks
Day 15: 20-Min Fat Loss Circuit (or Beginner version)
Day 19: 20-Min Full Body at Home (try to increase weight or reps)
Day 21: Rest — try a new recipe from your meal plan
Day 28: Rest — review your progress in the app
Day 30: Complete your favorite workout + celebrate!
